channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Nikolas provoca Lula e elogia Neymar após derrota do Brasil na Copa
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized President Lula and praised Neymar after Brazil's World Cup elimination, reviving the controversy over Lula's remark calling Neymar a 'home office player'. Ferreira said Neymar 'took responsibility for himself' by scoring Brazil's only goal in the 2-1 loss to Norway, suggesting that if Neymar had taken the penalty earlier, he would not have missed. He concluded by saying he 'just wants Lula to suffer'.

item.title: Esposa de Flávio Bolsonaro entrará na campanha
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), will take a more central role in the presidential campaign following accusations from stepmother Michelle of abuse and disrespect. She will undergo media training this month and may have her own social media team, focusing on health and targeting women, given her orthodontics specialization.

item.title: O aceno de paz de Alcolumbre ao governo Lula em matéria polêmica defendida por oposição
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is expected to reject the opposition's push to fast-track the homeschooling regulation bill, keeping it off the Senate's priority agenda. This stance is interpreted as a peace overture to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who opposes the measure, despite ongoing political tensions since November last year. Alcolumbre has previously inflicted defeats on Lula's government in key votes, underscoring his strategic independence.

item.title: Nikolas queria Neymar desde o início do jogo
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) posted a video lamenting Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, praising Neymar Jr. and criticizing President Lula, stating that the striker should have played from the start to improve the team's performance.

item.title: Tarifaço: governo Lula rebate acusações e vê ação política dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government rebutted U.S. allegations of unfair trade practices, including claims about Pix, stating there is no legal basis to justify 25% tariffs under Section 301. The document sent to the USTR defends Brazilian sovereignty, cites STF actions, and denies that Pix excludes foreign firms. While the government will not attend the hearing, Brazilian industry and agribusiness sectors will voice concerns about the economic impact of proposed tariffs on both countries.

item.title: Empresariado liga alerta para atuação de Flávio em audiência nos EUA
item.description: Brazilian business leaders are concerned about Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) participation in a U.S. hearing on a trade investigation that could lead to tariffs of up to 25% on Brazilian exports. They fear his advocacy for a 'zero-zero' reciprocity model on ethanol and sugar tariffs may weaken Brazil's negotiating position and politicize technical discussions. The meeting, held this Monday (July 6), includes U.S. officials, industry representatives, and the senator as a witness.

item.title: Brasil fora da Copa: Moro critica Gilmar e Nikolas defende Neymar
item.description: Following Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup by Norway, politicians from both the right and left expressed their views on social media. Sergio Moro (PL-PR) criticized Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, claiming the CBF 'controlled by Gilmar cannot succeed'. Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) defended Neymar, blamed Lula as the 'home office player', and told him to 'go to hell'. Adolfo Sachsida compared Ancelotti's coaching to the Lula government, while Kim Kataguiri called Brazil a 'shitty country' and said not even football could be a source of pride.

item.title: Contratado até 2030, Ancelotti promete lidar com a tristeza e recomeçar
item.description: Italian coach Carlo Ancelotti, hired until 2030 to lead the Brazilian national team, said after the 2026 World Cup elimination by Norway that he will cope with the disappointment and restart, emphasizing the current squad and the need to improve for the next cycle.

item.title: Do fim da 6 X 1 ao MEI, saiba o que ficará para depois do recesso
item.description: Brazil's legislature is entering its final week before the mid-year recess (July 18–31), with little expectation of significant votes. The PEC to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours (6 X 1) will be postponed until after the recess, making it unlikely to take effect before the October elections, as President Lula desires. Other proposals — including central bank autonomy, special retirement for health agents, raising the MEI revenue cap, and criminalizing misogyny — are also likely to be delayed, as the second half of the year will be dominated by elections, with party conventions from July 20 to August 5 and candidate registration closing on August 15.

item.title: Governo tem pautas importantes travadas no Senado, mas Lula evita aproximação com Alcolumbre
item.description: The Lula government has important pending agendas in the Senate that it aims to approve before the July recess, but avoids approaching Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches hinder the passage of key measures. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lula faz trocas em equipe do governo para reforçar pré-campanha à reeleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will begin staff changes at the Planalto Palace to strengthen his 2026 re-election pre-campaign. Key adjustments include assigning photographer Ricardo Stuckert to coordinate the campaign’s social media and dismissing three press office advisors to handle media relations for the campaign. These moves follow Lula’s intensified public agenda across states, as the electoral blackout period begins this Saturday and official campaigning starts on August 16.

item.title: As reformas são necessárias, mas falta liderança
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, declared that the Brazilian Republic is rotten and the Powers contaminated by inefficiency, undermining public trust. Ronaldo Caiado, presidential pre-candidate and head of the ticket, agreed, stating that Brazilian politics is dominated by corruption, backroom deals, and illegal and immoral agreements. The statements were made last week but did not lead to concrete actions beyond media coverage.

item.title: Governo Lula aposta em nova reunião e na oferta de redução de alíquotas para barrar tarifaço de Trump
item.description: The Lula government is seeking to avoid a 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods by offering reduced import tariffs on U.S.-dominated sectors and presenting a 'roadmap' covering digital trade, ethanol, deforestation, and other issues. Despite these efforts, officials express pessimism, believing the Trump administration has no interest in granting Lula a political victory ahead of the 2026 elections. There is also concern that the U.S. may support Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, who has already requested a delay in the tariffs, prompting the Brazilian government to prepare a narrative counter if he claims credit for any positive outcome.

item.title: Motta se reúne com bancada do agro e governo e tenta acordo para limitar impacto de pauta-bomba das dívidas rurais
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta is seeking an agreement between the ruralist caucus and the Lula government to limit the fiscal impact of rural debt renegotiation, which the original proposal would cost R$140 billion over ten years. The bill, expanded in the Senate to include producers affected by international conflicts like the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East, is considered a 'budget bomb' and will likely be debated only in the second semester after the parliamentary recess, with original rapporteur Afonso Hamm expected to retain his role.

item.title: Lula prepara lançamento oficial de campanha à reeleição para 2 de agosto após maratona de inaugurações
item.description: Lula is preparing to officially launch his re-election campaign on August 2 at the PT convention in São Paulo, following the completion of a series of government inauguration events. The shift from Brasília to São Paulo was made at Lula’s request, as he aims to replicate his 2022 performance in the state, which is seen as pivotal for the election. Until then, he will focus on closed-door sectoral meetings, avoiding public acts that could be construed as premature campaigning under electoral law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tenta se desvencilhar de tarifaço de Trump em audiência nos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is in the U.S. attending a USTR hearing on proposed tariffs against Brazil, urging the suspension of a 25% duty on Brazilian goods. He argues that the tariffs would politically benefit President Lula rather than pressure his administration, citing past Trump-era tariffs that allegedly boosted Lula’s electoral standing. Bolsonaro also criticized Lula, stating that while the president 'shows the middle finger,' he came to defend Brazilians in the United States.

item.title: Tribunais descumprem decisão do STF sobre penduricalhos e pagam salários de até R$ 495 mil a juízes
item.description: At least seven state courts disregarded an STF ruling that restricted judicial bonuses, paying judges salaries above the constitutional ceiling based on resolutions from the CNJ and CNMP. Payments reached up to R$ 495,000, constituting a direct defiance of the nation’s highest court.

item.title: Empresários brasileiros temem 'efeito Flávio' em audiência nos EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: Brazilian business leaders fear that remarks by Flávio Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo during the U.S. public hearing on U.S. tariffs against Brazil will inflame tensions and complicate negotiations with the American government.

item.title: Esforço de Lula para atrair trabalhadores de app pode não render resultado nas eleições
item.description: President Lula sought to court app-based workers, but his effort may yield little electoral gain due to the lack of progress on increasing their wages — a key demand for the group. Although these workers are largely perceived as right-leaning, the absence of salary improvements undermines the PT’s outreach strategy. The article suggests that without tangible gains, this political approach may fail to translate into votes in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eduardo e Flávio culpam PT por eliminação do Brasil na Copa
item.description: Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro linked Brazil’s elimination from the 2026 World Cup to the PT, claiming the team hasn’t won a World Cup since the party’s victory in 2002 — despite Brazil’s fifth title occurring under Fernando Henrique Cardoso. Eduardo repeated Flávio’s claim, cited Bruno Guimarães’ missed penalty, and shared a photo of Jair Bolsonaro with the team after the 2019 Copa América, ending with 'We lost the Cup, but we will win the country'.

item.title: Vini Jr. fala sobre pênalti perdido contra a Noruega: “Nunca fugi”
item.description: Vini Jr. explained that the missed penalty in Brazil's elimination against Norway was taken by Bruno Guimarães per coach Carlo Ancelotti's decision, based on statistical performance. He stated he never shirked responsibility and only takes penalties for Real Madrid when selected by the coach.

item.title: Lula pode ficar sem palanque em SP no 2º turno, sinaliza Datafolha
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll in São Paulo suggests Tarcísio de Freitas is likely to defeat Fernando Haddad in the first round of the state election, which could leave President Lula without a strong electoral base in the second round of the presidential race in Brazil’s largest electoral college. This poses a strategic challenge for Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Neymar indica seu futuro na seleção após eliminação para Noruega
item.description: Neymar suggested that Brazil's elimination to Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup may have been his final appearance for the national team, stating 'I tried, I tried. Now it's over. I started here, I finished here'. The forward scored his ninth World Cup goal and reached 80 goals for Brazil, but could not prevent a 2-1 loss.

item.title: Após eliminação do Brasil, políticos rivalizam sobre papel de Neymar
item.description: Following Brazil's elimination in the Round of 16 of the World Cup, politicians clashed over Neymar's role in the loss. Allies of Jair Bolsonaro, including Flávio Bolsonaro and Mario Frias, defended the player and mourned the team's exit, while critics such as André Janones and Renan Santos blamed Neymar for the team's performance, citing his alleged negative influence and questioning his selection.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro explora gesto de Lula e diz que presidente dá 'dedo do meio' à população
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for President from PL-RJ, criticized President Lula for making the middle finger gesture during an event at the Palácio do Planalto last Friday (May 3). He claimed the president was giving the 'middle finger' to the population, suggesting disrespect toward citizens. The comment comes amid rising political polarization ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após eliminação do Brasil na Copa, Flávio Bolsonaro liga derrota ao PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), senator and 2026 presidential pre-candidate, blamed Brazil's 2026 World Cup elimination on the PT's governance since 2002, claiming the country "hasn't won anything" since the party took power. Despite the 2-1 loss to Norway, he expressed optimism for his allies, stating "we will win Brazil," referring to the October presidential election. The article also notes inaccuracies in his statement, pointing out that Brazil had presidents from other parties (Temer in 2018, Jair Bolsonaro in 2022) in subsequent World Cups and won titles like the Copa América and Olympic gold.

item.title: Deputada em SP pede que Governo de SP crie regras para vetar celulares nas escolas
item.description: State Deputy Marina Helou (PSB) filed a representation with the São Paulo Public Ministry urging Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) to regulate the law restricting cellphone use in public schools. The measure aims to ensure effective implementation of the approved guidelines, focusing on discipline and learning environment.

item.title: As vantagens financeiras de uma vice mulher na candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is considering a female running mate to access campaign funds reserved for female candidates, allowing the PL party to use part of its R$ 881.6 million allocation to finance his presidential bid, provided the vice-presidential candidate also benefits. The law mandates that 30% of party funds go to women candidates but permits indirect funding of male candidates if it benefits the female candidate. The party has not yet named its vice-presidential pick but has mentioned Daniella Marques, Júlia Zanatta, and Priscila Costa as potential candidates.

item.title: Os ‘órfãos’ de Michelle Bolsonaro caso ela abandone a política
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro indicated she may withdraw from electoral politics to focus on her husband, former President Jair Bolsonaro, leaving several allies without her electoral support. Among those described as 'orphans' are Flávio Bolsonaro, Celina Leão, Luíza Cunha, Mariana Naime, and Eduardo Girão, who relied on her political influence, particularly among female and evangelical voters. Her potential departure weakens key PL candidacies and allied campaigns in regions such as the Federal District and Ceará.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz nos EUA que Lula quer 'tarifaço' para ter ganho político
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential pre-candidate from PL-RJ, accused President Lula of wanting the United States to impose tariffs on Brazil to gain political advantage. The statement was made during an event in the U.S. and represents another direct attack on his electoral rival ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após eliminação da seleção na Copa, adversários de Flávio Bolsonaro atacam Neymar: 'Joga nada'
item.description: Following Brazil's elimination from the World Cup, opponents of Flávio Bolsonaro, such as André Janones and Renan Santos, criticized Neymar for his performance and on-field tears, questioning his selection and play. In contrast, Bolsonarist allies like Tarcísio de Freitas and Mário Frias defended the player, emphasizing his emotional response and support for former president Jair Bolsonaro. The incident sparked a political debate on social media, highlighting the polarization surrounding Neymar's public image.

item.title: Luciano Huck desabafa e manda recado após a eliminação do Brasil
item.description: Luciano Huck expressed sadness over Brazil's elimination by Norway in the 2026 World Cup round of 16, acknowledging his optimism as a fan while urging the team to learn from its mistakes. He voiced continued belief in the squad and coach Carlo Ancelotti, calling for forward-looking planning toward the 2030 World Cup.

item.title: SELEÇÃO PERDE NA COPA: BRASIL DE VERDADE É AGORA, ELEIÇÕES 2026, NORUEGA, STF, MORAES, FLÁVIO, LULA
item.description: The content associated with the title appears to be a YouTube video with playback failure, containing no substantive political material about the 2026 Brazilian elections. There are no clear mentions of candidates, policy proposals, or relevant electoral events. The title suggests a symbolic link between Brazil's loss in the World Cup and a supposed 'true Brazil' in the 2026 elections, but the content does not develop this idea.

item.title: O fim do sonho do hexa da Copa: da expectativa por Neymar a um time ainda em construção por Ancelotti
item.description: Brazil was eliminated in the round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup after a 2-1 loss to Norway. Coach Carlo Ancelotti faced multiple injuries, including Neymar’s grade 2 calf strain, Rodrygo, Estêvão, Éder Militão, Wesley and Raphinha, leaving the squad depleted. Although Vinicius Jr. stood out with key goals in the group stage, the team remains a work in progress and failed to reach the quarterfinals.

item.title: Datafolha: coordenador de campanha de Haddad reage a Tarcísio à frente
item.description: Fernando Haddad's (PT) pre-campaign coordinator, Emídio de Souza, says Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' (Republicanos) 16-point lead over Haddad (30%) could shrink once mandatory electoral advertising on radio and TV begins. Although Tarcísio's lead increased from 13 to 16 points since the March Datafolha poll, the change falls within the 2-point margin of error, so a real widening cannot be confirmed. The survey interviewed 1,608 voters in São Paulo between July 1 and 3, and is registered with the TSE under codes SP-01703/2026 and BR-06481/2026.

item.title: Jair Renan anuncia pré-candidatura a deputado federal por SC
item.description: Balneário Camboriú city councilor and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, Jair Renan Bolsonaro, announced on Sunday (July 5, 2026) his pre-candidacy for federal deputy from Santa Catarina. In a post on X, he said he would continue his father’s mission, defending the values of God, Homeland, Family, and Liberty, and noted that his brother, Flávio Bolsonaro, is also a pre-candidate for President of the Republic.

item.title: Lula é “o único no mundo” a querer tarifa dos EUA, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused President Lula of being 'the only one in the world' advocating for U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, claiming the president believes such a measure would bring him political gains. The statement was made during a live broadcast on Sunday, the 5th, as a pre-candidate for president from PL-RJ.

item.title: Nos EUA, Flávio Bolsonaro faz live e acusa Lula de querer tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, in the United States, accused President Lula of wanting the U.S. tariff on Brazilian products to gain political advantage, claiming the government does not combat corruption. He said he attended a hearing at the USTR and sent a letter requesting a delay, arguing the tariff would benefit Lula in the 2026 election.

item.title: Líder do PL ironiza pênalti perdido pelo Brasil: "Foi aos 13 minutos"
item.description: PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante mocked Brazil's missed penalty in the 13th minute against Norway in the 2026 World Cup, linking the number 13 to the PT party and calling it a 'plague'. He and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro have used numerical coincidences in matches to make political claims, such as attributing Martinelli's goal (wearing number 22) to the PL's electoral number 22.

item.title: Pauta de Flávio, PCC tirou o sono de Bolsonaro, que projetava desgaste e impeachment
item.description: The designation of the PCC and CV as international terrorist organizations by the Trump administration has bolstered Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, yet it exposes a contradiction with his father Jair Bolsonaro's earlier stance, which feared that targeting the PCC could trigger inmate rebellions and fuel an impeachment process. In 2019, Jair Bolsonaro urged Sergio Moro to halt the transfer of PCC leaders, including Marcola, citing concerns over potential retaliation by organized crime and political blame. Flávio is now attempting to link Lula to the PCC, citing the arrest of a petista councilman, despite his own campaign being marred by controversies such as audio leaks requesting campaign finance and public disputes with Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Moro visita Filipe Martins e cobra aplicação da Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR Sergio Moro visited Filipe Martins, former presidential aide convicted by the STF for the January 8 attacks, and advocated for the application of the Dosimetry Law, stating Martins should already be serving his sentence. The meeting took place on Sunday, January 5, and was reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Pivô de atrito entre Michelle e Flávio pede união contra o PT
item.description: Fortaleza councilwoman Priscila Costa (PL-CE) urged reconciliation between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, stating their conflict benefits the PT and reaffirming her support for Flávio’s Senate pre-candidacy. She emphasized her support is longstanding, dating back to Michelle’s endorsement of the PL Women’s national project, countering claims of recent allegiance.

item.title: A outra boa notícia para Tarcísio de Freitas na pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, the Republicanos candidate for re-election, has a 45% approval rating as 'excellent' or 'good' in governance, according to the latest Datafolha poll, showing stability from the previous survey (44%). His overall approval stands at 63%, surpassing most predecessors like Alckmin (39%) and Doria (23%), though 46% of voters believe he has underperformed expectations. He leads in voting intention with 46%, compared to Fernando Haddad (PT) at 30%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai aos EUA discutir tarifaço enquanto governo negocia
item.description: The Brazilian government is making its final efforts this week to avoid a new U.S. tariff hike on Brazilian products, proposed as part of an ongoing trade investigation. Meanwhile, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is traveling to the U.S. to discuss the tariff issue.

item.title: Se Neymar estiver bem, pode entrar e fazer a diferença, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Neymar could enter the match against Norway and make a difference if physically fit and pain-free. He also expressed confidence that the Brazilian team can reach the final and win the World Cup. The comment was made in a video posted by First Lady Janja on Instagram, where Lula was seen placing stickers in a personalized album about his own life.

item.title: Governo teme que veto à carne brasileira eleve preço no mercado interno
item.description: The Lula government is concerned that the European Union’s veto on Brazilian beef, set to take effect in September, could raise domestic prices ahead of the 2026 elections. The restriction may reduce export volumes and tighten domestic supply, creating inflationary pressure in a politically sensitive electoral period.

item.title: Nikolas associa permanência no Bolsa Família à perda de dignidade
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) linked continued receipt of Bolsa Família to a loss of dignity among beneficiaries, in a podcast clip circulated in July 2026. He argued that receiving the benefit constitutes a trade-off of personal dignity, sparking controversy on social media. The program supports approximately 18 million vulnerable families in Brazil.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro desembarca nos EUA e critica Lula: 'Enquanto ele mostra o dedo do meio, vim defender os brasileiros'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) arrived in the U.S. to attend a hearing at the USTR, claiming to defend Brazilian companies from potential tariffs proposed by Trump. He criticized Lula for making a middle-finger gesture during a government event, stating that while the president shows disrespect to the people, he is in Washington defending Brazilians. This marks his sixth trip to the U.S. this year, exceeding his visits to key electoral states ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: Flávio diz nos EUA que Lula quer tarifaço de Trump para ter ganho político
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claims President Lula wants the U.S. to impose 25% tariffs on Brazil for political gain, during a USTR public hearing in Washington. He submitted an 86-page letter arguing the tariffs would benefit Lula politically, despite harming the economy. Lula responded by accusing the Bolsonaro family of betrayal for seeking to submit Brazil to U.S. interests.

item.title: Lula diz torcer para Neymar jogar e "fazer a diferença" em jogo contra a Noruega
item.description: President Lula said he is rooting for the Brazilian national team in their match against Norway, emphasizing the importance of winning and hoping Neymar plays and 'makes a difference'. He also stated that women can play soccer as well as men during an exchange with a child. The remarks were made in a video posted by First Lady Janja on social media.
